seoTitle: Azure Monitor Diagnostic Log Viewer for Exported JSON
metaDescription: Parse Azure diagnostic log JSON into counts by category, level, operation and result, and a searchable table. Free, runs locally.
intro: Reads diagnostic records from storage blobs, Event Hubs or Log Analytics exports and summarises them.
why:
Azure diagnostic logs use different field names per resource type and per export path. This tool tries the common names (time, category, level, operationName, resultType) and shows the rest in a detail column.

Search is a plain text match over the whole record.
howTo: Filter by category, level or text.
Read the summary or the table.
